# LaunchLoom progress, 30 October 2026

## 15:40 UTC - View site opens the verified site URL

- Task: Work OS ledger parent `1854f10b-cefd-41c0-b8b0-a5335c428adb`.
- Branch/worktree: `codex/launchloom-view-site-link` from `origin/main` at
  `6e69bf72`.
- Cause: the site-timeline "View site" control called `onOpenClient`, so it
  opened the client dossier. The attempt and client records did not carry the
  client preview URL: attempt summaries only allow the focused diagnostic
  preview host, so the `review-initial` client Pages URL was nulled.
- Fix: `AttemptSummary` gains a display-only `siteUrl`, resolved by
  `GenerationLedger` from the trusted issue completion record
  (`generations.preview_url`) for delivered attempts only. A failed attempt in
  the same timeline does not borrow the URL.
- Fix: "View site" renders a real `https://...` link with `target="_blank"` and
  `rel="noreferrer"` when `siteUrl` exists. Without a URL the control is labeled
  "Open client" so it no longer implies a site link.
- Validation: 48 admin workspace browser tests passed, including the default
  Sites link assertion; 33 worker attempt and tracking tests passed; `npm run
  check` reported 0 errors and 0 warnings across 464 files.
- Remaining: merge, deploy, and confirm the live Northline "View site" link
  opens the review preview.

## 17:50 UTC - One site truth, real sites only, and honest freshness

- Task: Work OS ledger parent `bbe5af4e-bca5-4bfa-a076-baec1894b700`.
- Branch/worktree: `codex/launchloom-dashboard-truth`; merged from
  `origin/main` before deployment.
- Site truth: `GenerationLedger` resolves one display `siteUrl` per issue from
  the trusted `generations` row and exposes it on attempts and clients. The
  attempt inspector, client dossier, client directory and operations table all
  use it. Client dossiers also query by issue, so manually dispatched
  generations are no longer missing from the client's history.
- Sites view: only `full` and `full-preview` generations are fetched for the
  Sites view (`siteOnly` filter). Creative and SEO probes remain in Ledger and
  Gallery. Site cards collapse to three timeline rows, name fallback intakes
  from the generation business name, and link each intake to GitHub.
- Client directory: accepted intakes for the same business (or email when no
  business name exists) render as one site row with an intake disclosure and a
  verified site link.
- Freshness: `Health.latestAttemptAt` is separate from reconciliation time.
  The permanent "0 pending projections and partial coverage" banner is replaced
  by explicit backlog, acceptance, coverage and reconciliation facts. The page
  shows a real relative update time and polls every 15 seconds while a run is
  active.
- Filters: status chips now preserve the client filter and use counts scoped to
  the active client, view and search. The `All` chip no longer mixes a global
  total with filtered status counts.
- Primary surface: the working view is now `Sites` / `Client sites`; the
  hidden Operations pointer and duplicate read-only banner are gone. If
  Operations is enabled, its table includes the client and verified site.
- Accessibility and mobile: the site timeline status spans the content columns
  at 900px and below, site names use `h2`, the brand accessible name matches its
  visible text, and client table headers, chip counts and preview placeholders
  meet contrast.
- Validation: 52 admin workspace browser tests passed; 75 worker attempt,
  workspace API, tracking and operations tests passed; 63 site/client/API unit
  tests passed; `npm run check` reported 0 errors and 0 warnings across 490
  files; `npm run build:admin` produced the admin bundle.
- Remaining: commit, PR, deploy, and verify the live Sites, Clients and attempt
  inspector surfaces against the Northline record.
## Route-fixture CI cost reduction

- Work OS `51f30f1a-8065-466a-ab32-e2f4648caeee`. Branch `codex/launchloom-route-ci-opt`, worktree `/home/maigreeks/projects/.worktrees/launchloom-route-ci-opt`, based on `origin/main` `5e2f7775`.
- Benchmark evidence: the 4-vCPU VPS matches GitHub for the 695-second validate job but route fixtures cost 710-784 seconds on every PR. The VPS is not a useful runner replacement on the shared production host.
- Change: classify PR paths into runtime and route impact. Route fixtures run in full for client-site, render, route-verification, fixture, dependency and workflow changes. Unrelated runtime PRs now run a no-op successful `route-fixtures` check instead of the 12-minute suite. A nightly 05:00 UTC schedule and manual dispatch run the full route suite.
- Validation: YAML parses with the expected outputs and job conditions; classify shell syntax passes; simulated path cases produce runtime/routes `true/true`, `true/false`, and `false/false` correctly.
- No gate is removed: the nightly schedule covers every route path, and relevant PRs still run the full suite. No production deployment or runtime code changed.
